run-rich-3d.title: Run Rich 3D - Free Online Game
run-rich-3d.description: Run Rich 3D is an exciting 3D running game where you collect money bills to upgrade your outfit. Avoid obstacles like bottles and trash cans to stay rich. With simple controls and engaging gameplay, Run Rich 3D offers hours of fun. Play Run Rich 3D now and see how far you can go!
